photos.name: crumb-cross-section
photos.summary: Cross-section of the loaf cut in half on a cutting board, showing an open, evenly distributed crumb with a mix of medium and small holes and a thin golden crust.

photos.name: dough-temp-check-bulk
photos.summary: Digital thermometer reading 77.4°F inserted into the dough during bulk fermentation, with the dough resting in a glass mixing bowl.

photos.name: finished-loaf-closeup-ear
photos.summary: Close-up of the baked loaf on a wire cooling rack, showing a single side score with a lifted ear, deep caramelized crust, and prominent fermentation blisters across the surface.

photos.name: finished-loaf-wide-cooling-rack
photos.summary: Wide shot of the finished boule cooling on a round copper wire rack, showing golden-brown crust covered in fermentation blisters and a subtle score line on top.
